notes.title: Quality of Life and Arabic Translation
notes.content:
Hi!

I've been working on an update recently to change my mind from working on Manufactur'inc demo, my factory management game.

Changes:

 Compressed images so they'll be lighter on your hard drive and to download for new users
 Setup the new official wiki at https://wiki.dysnomia.studio and I added a link to this wiki on the main menu
 Arabic translation thanks to the community member @FlenderrAX on Github
 #1813 - Merge Notifications are bugged on Steam Deck
 #1812 - Reduce "delete save" popup fade time
 #1721 - Save list: show progress
 #1825 - When restarting a sandbox game, the time isn't reset, the next win will display the old timer
 #1810 - New recipes to make the early game and the demo easier
 #1805 - When trying to grab two elements on top of each other, we should grab the most "upwards" one
 #1794 - When hovering bottom-left buttons, the tooltip is "true" instead of the right text
 Remove the twitter link from the Menu
 Developer side: Update lots of technical dependencies


I hope you'll enjoy this update and the game :)
Have a good day!

Elanis

notes.title: Alchemistry v1.5.0 is now out!
notes.content:
Hello!

This update was supposed to be released for Alchemistry second aniversary but planning went ... 2 month off 😅

But I finally found time to fix the bugs blocking me and write some other improvements at the same time.

Changes:

 Improved performances, 60 fps should be even lighter (CPU-wise) to achieve now
 Updated bottom right links on the main menu (removed Reddit, added Mastodon/Patreon)
 Added a new difficulty: Hardcore mode, which hides every hint in the sandbox game
 Show already discovered recipes when hovering an element (except in hardcore mode)
 Hovering an element in the bottom bar now highlights the next spawn location with a point on the board
 Re-enabled mouse/touchpad scrolling for the bottom bar
 Improved positioning algorithm to fit more elements into the screen without the needs to move the board
 Added 5 new challenges


Housekeeping:

 Improved Automated tests
 Updated a lot of developer dependencies


I hope you will enjoy this update!
You can check out the game roadmap at: https://bugs.dysnomia.studio/projects/alchemistry/roadmap to see the following ones.

I also want to talk about another project I am working on. If you like industry management games where we talk about ethics, optimizations, and lots of other stuff, take a look at my next game, Manufactur'inc. I already wrote six DevBlogs about the game, and the last one just has been published!

If you're interested in the game, please wishlist and/or follow it! It would mean a great deal to me.

Thanks again for your support, and have fun!
Elanis

notes.title: Price update following Steam Recommandation
notes.content:
Hello !

As you can see on Steam right now, recommanded prices have been updated by Valve for developers.

Immediatly with theses recommanded prices, I adjusted price of both Dysnomia games to keep the same euro price.

What does that mean ?

Most prices will fluctuate between -15% and +20%:
- US Dollar prices lowered by 17% to 4.99$ (-1$)
- British pound prices lowered by 11% to 4.29£ (-0.5£)
- Canadian dollar prices lowered by 3% to 6.49$ (-0.2$)
- Russian ruble increased by 29% to 200₽ (+46₽)
And so on

You can see price variations on SteamDb by selecting your currency: https://steamdb.info/app/1730540/

Have fun !
Elanis

notes.title: Lags patch
notes.content:
Hi !

I got report that people were experiencing lags, and I finally found what was causing them. There were a problem with Steam Cloud save happening multiple time per second, and I wasn't able to see it in my development environment. So, changes in this update:

- Fix #1406 - Slow FPS on Steam Version
- Fix #1404 - Cannot change Music volume more than once (side effect from previous patch)

Check out roadmap for next updates: https://bugs.dysnomia.studio/projects/alchemistry/roadmap
